question_text: Under Article VIII of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following correctly describes the composition of the Supreme Court and the qualifications of its members?

options.text: The Supreme Court is composed of a Chief Justice and 14 Associate Justices, all of whom must be natural-born citizens, at least 40 years old, and have at least 15 years of experience as a judge or lawyer.

The Supreme Court is composed of a Chief Justice and 12 Associate Justices, all of whom must be natural-born citizens, at least 35 years old, and have at least 10 years of experience as a judge or lawyer.

The Supreme Court is composed of a Chief Justice and 14 Associate Justices, all of whom must be natural-born citizens, at least 35 years old, and have at least 10 years of experience as a judge or lawyer.

The Supreme Court is composed of a Chief Justice and 12 Associate Justices, all of whom must be natural-born citizens, at least 40 years old, and have at least 15 years of experience as a judge or lawyer.
